integrity: The statements follow from an explicit conditional expectation identity and algebra; exact finite-graph enumeration is corroborative rather than a proof of unbounded size.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous independent edges; isolated complete components versus all complete subgraphs only. The finite-size threshold ordering need not follow the asymptotic order. Earlier implicit inclusion in general component/subgraph generating functions remains a priority risk.
title: Exact sign transitions between isolated clique components and embedded cliques
